// The night of 10M grown by inserts (bench-report.md of
// feat/posting-edge-index, "10M crecido por inserts"): TestNightGrow grows
// the index, TestNightHeap opens what it left and profiles the heap.
//
// Parameters, from the environment:
//   - PE_DATASET: a raw dataset directory (meta.txt, train.f32 or
//     train.embedded with a train_offset line), already L2-normalized.
//   - PE_DIR: where the index goes; empty for TestNightGrow.
//   - PE_OUT: the JSON written after every stretch (TestNightGrow) or at the
//     end (TestNightHeap).
//   - PE_N: how many train rows go in (all of them if 0).
//   - PE_CALLERS: how many callers add at once once there is a base (8).
//   - PE_CACHE: the rq.cacheMode (routing).
//   - PE_BUDGET: the budget of what waits of the edges, in bytes (0 for the
//     default of the index).
//   - PE_STRETCH: the seconds of a stretch (300).
//   - PE_MINFREE: the GB the disk of PE_DIR must keep free; under it the run
//     stops, shutting the index first (8).
//   - PE_HEAP: the heap profile TestNightHeap writes (run it with
//     -test.memprofilerate=1).

func nightEnvInt(t *testing.T, name string, def int64) int64 {
	s := os.Getenv(name)
	if s == "" {
		return def
	}
	v, err := strconv.ParseInt(s, 10, 64)
	require.NoError(t, err, name)
	return v
}

func nightEnv(name, def string) string {
	if s := os.Getenv(name); s != "" {
		return s
	}
	return def
}

// nightTrain is the train set of a raw dataset, read a vector at a time from
// its file: 10M vectors of 768 dimensions are 30.7 GB, more than the run
// should hold.
type nightTrain struct {
	file   *os.File
	offset int64
	rows   int
	dims   int
}

func openNightTrain(dir string) (*nightTrain, error) {
	meta, err := os.Open(filepath.Join(dir, "meta.txt"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer meta.Close()
	shapes := map[string][2]int{}
	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(meta)
	for scanner.Scan() {
		fields := strings.Fields(scanner.Text())
		if len(fields) != 3 {
			continue
		}
		a, errA := strconv.Atoi(fields[1])
		b, errB := strconv.Atoi(fields[2])
		if errA == nil && errB == nil {
			shapes[fields[0]] = [2]int{a, b}
		}
	}
	if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	shape, ok := shapes["train"]
	if !ok {
		return nil, errors.Errorf("%s: no train line in meta.txt", dir)
	}
	path := filepath.Join(dir, "train.f32")
	if _, err := os.Stat(path); err != nil {
		path = filepath.Join(dir, "train.embedded")
	}
	file, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &nightTrain{file: file, offset: int64(shapes["train_offset"][0]), rows: shape[0], dims: shape[1]}, nil
}

// read reads the vectors of ids into vectors, reusing buf.
func (tr *nightTrain) read(ids []uint64, buf []byte) ([][]float32, []byte, error) {
	size := 4 * tr.dims
	if cap(buf) < size {
		buf = make([]byte, size)
	}
	buf = buf[:size]
	vectors := make([][]float32, len(ids))
	for i, id := range ids {
		if _, err := tr.file.ReadAt(buf, tr.offset+int64(id)*int64(size)); err != nil {
			return nil, buf, errors.Wrapf(err, "read train row %d", id)
		}
		vec := make([]float32, tr.dims)
		byteops.CopyBytesToSlice(vec, buf)
		vectors[i] = vec
	}
	return vectors, buf, nil
}

// nightShardBucketOptions are the options a shard gives the buckets of its
// vector index (Shard.makeDefaultBucketOptions) with the defaults of a node:
// no allocation checker, no pread, segments of any size, dynamic memtables of
// 10 to 200 MB, and every segment loaded when the store opens.
func nightShardBucketOptions(strategy string, custom ...lsmkv.BucketOption) []lsmkv.BucketOption {
	options := []lsmkv.BucketOption{
		lsmkv.WithStrategy(strategy),
		lsmkv.WithPread(false),
		lsmkv.WithMaxSegmentSize(math.MaxInt64),
		lsmkv.WithSegmentsChecksumValidationEnabled(false),
		lsmkv.WithMinMMapSize(8192),
		lsmkv.WithMinWalThreshold(4096),
		lsmkv.WithWriteSegmentInfoIntoFileName(true),
		lsmkv.WithWriteMetadata(false),
		lsmkv.WithDirtyThreshold(60 * time.Second),
		lsmkv.WithSegmentsCleanupInterval(0),
		lsmkv.WithDynamicMemtableSizing(10<<20, 200<<20, 15, 45),
		lsmkv.WithLazySegmentLoading(false),
	}
	return append(options, custom...)
}

// nightStore is the store of a shard with its cycles: flush and compaction
// on the tickers of a node, and the tombstone and commit log cycles of a
// vector index. With cycles false they are groups no one calls, for an open
// that only measures.
type nightStore struct {
	store                  *lsmkv.Store
	flush, compaction      cyclemanager.CycleCallbackGroup
	tombstones, commitLogs cyclemanager.CycleCallbackGroup
	managers               []cyclemanager.CycleManager
}

func openNightStore(t *testing.T, dir string, logger logrus.FieldLogger, cycles bool) *nightStore {
	s := &nightStore{}
	if !cycles {
		noop := cyclemanager.NewCallbackGroupNoop()
		s.flush, s.compaction, s.tombstones, s.commitLogs = noop, noop, noop, noop
	} else {
		routines := 2 * runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0)
		s.compaction = cyclemanager.NewCallbackGroup("night/compaction", logger, routines)
		s.flush = cyclemanager.NewCallbackGroup("night/flush", logger, routines)
		s.tombstones = cyclemanager.NewCallbackGroup("night/tombstones", logger, routines)
		s.commitLogs = cyclemanager.NewCallbackGroup("night/commitlogs", logger, routines)
		s.managers = []cyclemanager.CycleManager{
			cyclemanager.NewManager("night/compaction", cyclemanager.CompactionCycleTicker(true), s.compaction.CycleCallback, logger),
			cyclemanager.NewManager("night/flush", cyclemanager.MemtableFlushCycleTicker(true), s.flush.CycleCallback, logger),
			cyclemanager.NewManager("night/commitlogs", cyclemanager.HnswCommitLoggerCycleTicker(true), s.commitLogs.CycleCallback, logger),
			cyclemanager.NewManager("night/tombstones", cyclemanager.NewFixedTicker(300*time.Second), s.tombstones.CycleCallback, logger),
		}
	}
	var err error
	s.store, err = lsmkv.New(filepath.Join(dir, "lsm"), dir, logger, nil, nil, s.compaction,
		cyclemanager.NewCallbackGroupNoop(), s.flush)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	for _, m := range s.managers {
		m.Start()
	}
	return s
}

func (s *nightStore) config(dir string, logger logrus.FieldLogger, budget int64) PersistentConfig {
	return PersistentConfig{
		ID:                 "main",
		ShardName:          "night",
		ClassName:          "Night",
		RootPath:           dir,
		Logger:             logger,
		DistanceProvider:   distancer.NewCosineDistanceProvider(),
		MakeBucketOptions:  nightShardBucketOptions,
		TombstoneCallbacks: s.tombstones,
		CommitLogCallbacks: s.commitLogs,
		// HNSWMaxLogSize of a node over five, as a shard gives it.
		CommitLogThreshold: (500 << 20) / 5,
		pendingBudget:      budget,
	}
}

// stopCycles stops the managers of the cycles, before the store shuts.
func (s *nightStore) stopCycles(ctx context.Context) {
	for _, m := range s.managers {
		<-m.Stop(ctx)
	}
	s.managers = nil
}

// nightRusage is what the system accounts to this process so far
// (proc_pid_rusage, RUSAGE_INFO_V2): the bytes it read from and wrote to
// disk, its page-ins and its footprint.
type nightRusage struct {
	BytesRead    uint64 `json:"diskBytesRead"`
	BytesWritten uint64 `json:"diskBytesWritten"`
	Pageins      uint64 `json:"pageins"`
	Footprint    uint64 `json:"physFootprint"`
	UserNs       uint64 `json:"userNs"`
	SystemNs     uint64 `json:"systemNs"`
}

func readNightRusage() (nightRusage, error) {
	const procInfoCallPidRusage, rusageInfoV2 = 9, 2
	var buf [256]byte
	_, _, errno := syscall.Syscall6(syscall.SYS_PROC_INFO, procInfoCallPidRusage, uintptr(os.Getpid()), rusageInfoV2, 0,
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&buf[0])), 0)
	if errno != 0 {
		return nightRusage{}, errors.Wrap(errno, "read the resource usage of the process")
	}
	// The uint64 of index i of rusage_info_v2, after its uuid of 16 bytes.
	word := func(i int) uint64 { return binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(buf[16+8*i:]) }
	// Its times are in units of mach_absolute_time: 125/3 ns on Apple silicon.
	ns := func(i int) uint64 {
		if runtime.GOARCH == "arm64" {
			return word(i) * 125 / 3
		}
		return word(i)
	}
	return nightRusage{
		UserNs: ns(0), SystemNs: ns(1), Pageins: word(4), Footprint: word(7),
		BytesRead: word(16), BytesWritten: word(17),
	}, nil
}

// nightDirBytes sums the sizes of the files under dir.
func nightDirBytes(dir string) (int64, error) {
	var total int64
	err := filepath.WalkDir(dir, func(_ string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil {
			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
				return nil
			}
			return err
		}
		if d.IsDir() {
			return nil
		}
		info, err := d.Info()
		if err != nil {
			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
				return nil
			}
			return err
		}
		total += info.Size()
		return nil
	})
	return total, err
}

func nightFreeBytes(dir string) (uint64, error) {
	var st syscall.Statfs_t
	if err := syscall.Statfs(dir, &st); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	return st.Bavail * uint64(st.Bsize), nil
}

type nightStretch struct {
	At        string  `json:"at"`
	Inserted  int     `json:"inserted"`
	Seconds   float64 `json:"seconds"`
	PerSecond float64 `json:"perSecond"`
	// PostingsGivenOut counts every posting id the index has given, retired
	// ones included; LivePostings those not retired.
	PostingsGivenOut int `json:"postingsGivenOut"`
	LivePostings     int `json:"livePostings"`
	Splits           int `json:"splits"`
	// Rows of edges written, and by the budget, so far; what waits now.
	RowWrites       growIO `json:"rowWrites"`
	RowWritesBudget int    `json:"rowWritesBudget"`
	RowDists        growIO `json:"rowDistWrites"`
	PendingLog      growIO `json:"pendingLogWrites"`
	PendingHeap     int64  `json:"pendingHeap"`
	PendingPostings int    `json:"pendingPostings"`
	PendingMembers  int64  `json:"pendingMembers"`
	JournalRecords  int64  `json:"journalRecords"`
	JournalBytes    int64  `json:"journalBytes"`
	// What the system accounted to the process, so far, and the write
	// amplification of this stretch: the bytes written to disk over the bytes
	// of the vectors that went in (4 a dimension).
	Rusage             nightRusage `json:"rusage"`
	WriteAmplification float64     `json:"writeAmplification"`
	DirBytes           int64       `json:"dirBytes"`
	FreeBytes          uint64      `json:"freeBytes"`
	HeapInuse          uint64      `json:"heapInuse"`
	HeapAlloc          uint64      `json:"heapAlloc"`
	NumGC              uint32      `json:"numGC"`
}

type nightResult struct {
	Dataset      string         `json:"dataset"`
	Rows         int            `json:"rows"`
	Dims         int            `json:"dims"`
	Callers      int            `json:"callers"`
	CacheMode    string         `json:"cacheMode"`
	Budget       int64          `json:"pendingBudget"`
	Procs        int            `json:"procs"`
	Base         int            `json:"base"`
	BaseSeconds  float64        `json:"baseSeconds"`
	Inserted     int            `json:"inserted"`
	Seconds      float64        `json:"seconds"`
	SettleSecs   float64        `json:"settleSeconds"`
	ShutSeconds  float64        `json:"shutSeconds"`
	Stretches    []nightStretch `json:"stretches"`
	Meta         growMeta       `json:"meta"`
	Stats        growStats      `json:"stats"`
	DirBytesDone int64          `json:"dirBytesAtEnd"`
	Done         bool           `json:"done"`
}

func writeNightJSON(t *testing.T, path string, v any) {
	raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(v, "", "  ")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, raw, 0o644))
}

// TestNightGrow grows an index by inserts from the dataset, in the shuffled
// order of the scale runs (TestIntegrationScale), through the index a shard
// opens over a store opened as a shard opens its own. The base is the
// default of the index; after it, PE_CALLERS callers add a batch of 100 each
// at once, and the index is flushed after every round, as a shard flushes its
// indexes after a request that writes. Every stretch writes PE_OUT again.
func TestNightGrow(t *testing.T) {
	datasetDir, dir, out := os.Getenv("PE_DATASET"), os.Getenv("PE_DIR"), os.Getenv("PE_OUT")
	if datasetDir == "" || dir == "" || out == "" {
		t.Skip("no PE_DATASET, PE_DIR and PE_OUT given")
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	train, err := openNightTrain(datasetDir)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer train.file.Close()
	n := train.rows
	if limit := int(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_N", 0)); limit > 0 {
		n = min(n, limit)
	}
	callers := int(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_CALLERS", 8))
	budget := nightEnvInt(t, "PE_BUDGET", 0)
	stretchEvery := time.Duration(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_STRETCH", 300)) * time.Second
	minFree := uint64(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_MINFREE", 8)) << 30

	require.NoError(t, os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755))
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(dir)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Empty(t, entries, "%s is not empty", dir)

	logger := logrus.New()
	logger.SetLevel(logrus.WarnLevel)
	uc := ent.NewDefaultUserConfig()
	uc.RQ.CacheMode = nightEnv("PE_CACHE", ent.CacheModeRouting)
	st := openNightStore(t, dir, logger, true)
	p, err := Open(st.config(dir, logger, budget), uc, st.store)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	shut := func() {
		if p == nil {
			return
		}
		begin := time.Now()
		require.NoError(t, p.Flush())
		require.NoError(t, p.Shutdown(ctx))
		st.stopCycles(ctx)
		require.NoError(t, st.store.Shutdown(ctx))
		p = nil
		t.Logf("shut in %s", time.Since(begin).Round(time.Second))
	}
	defer shut()

	order := make([]uint64, train.rows)
	for i := range order {
		order[i] = uint64(i)
	}
	rand.New(rand.NewPCG(1, 1)).Shuffle(len(order), func(i, j int) { order[i], order[j] = order[j], order[i] })
	order = order[:n]

	result := &nightResult{
		Dataset: datasetDir, Rows: n, Dims: train.dims, Callers: callers, CacheMode: uc.RQ.CacheMode,
		Budget: p.cfg.pendingBudget, Procs: runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0),
	}
	const batch = 100
	inserted := 0
	begin := time.Now()
	var insertTime time.Duration
	lastAt, lastInserted := time.Now(), 0
	last, err := readNightRusage()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	stretch := func() {
		now := time.Now()
		usage, err := readNightRusage()
		require.NoError(t, err)
		var mem runtime.MemStats
		runtime.ReadMemStats(&mem)
		dirBytes, err := nightDirBytes(dir)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		free, err := nightFreeBytes(dir)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		s := nightStretch{
			At: now.Format("15:04:05"), Inserted: inserted, Seconds: now.Sub(begin).Seconds(),
			PerSecond: float64(inserted-lastInserted) / now.Sub(lastAt).Seconds(),
			Rusage:    usage, DirBytes: dirBytes, FreeBytes: free,
			HeapInuse: mem.HeapInuse, HeapAlloc: mem.HeapAlloc, NumGC: mem.NumGC,
		}
		if vectors := inserted - lastInserted; vectors > 0 {
			s.WriteAmplification = float64(usage.BytesWritten-last.BytesWritten) / float64(vectors*4*train.dims)
		}
		p.mu.RLock()
		g := p.g
		s.PostingsGivenOut, s.Splits = g.meta.Postings, g.meta.Splits
		s.RowWrites, s.RowWritesBudget, s.RowDists, s.PendingLog = g.stats.RowWrites, g.stats.RowWritesBudget,
			g.stats.RowDists, g.stats.PendingLog
		s.PendingHeap, s.PendingPostings, s.PendingMembers = g.pendingHeap(), len(g.pending), g.pendingMembers
		if g.journal != nil {
			s.JournalRecords, s.JournalBytes = g.journal.records, g.journal.bytes
		}
		result.Meta, result.Stats = g.meta, g.stats
		p.mu.RUnlock()
		s.LivePostings = livePostings(g)
		result.Stretches = append(result.Stretches, s)
		result.Inserted, result.Seconds = inserted, insertTime.Seconds()
		writeNightJSON(t, out, result)
		t.Logf("%s %d of %d in (%.1f %%): %.0f inserts a second | %d postings live, %d given out | rows of edges "+
			"%.0f B an insert so far, %d by the budget | waiting %.1f MB | written %.2f times the vectors | heap %.0f MB | "+
			"%.1f GB on disk, %.1f GB free",
			s.At, inserted, n, 100*float64(inserted)/float64(n), s.PerSecond, s.LivePostings, s.PostingsGivenOut,
			float64(s.RowWrites.Bytes)/float64(max(inserted-result.Base, 1)), s.RowWritesBudget,
			float64(s.PendingHeap)/1e6, s.WriteAmplification, float64(mem.HeapInuse)/1e6, float64(dirBytes)/1e9,
			float64(free)/1e9)
		lastAt, lastInserted, last = now, inserted, usage
		if free < minFree {
			shut()
			t.Fatalf("STOP: %.1f GB free on the disk of %s, under %d GB: the index is shut with %d of %d in",
				float64(free)/1e9, dir, minFree>>30, inserted, n)
		}
	}

	bufs := make([][]byte, callers)
	for inserted < n {
		wasBuilt := p.g != nil
		round := 1
		if wasBuilt {
			round = callers
		}
		to := min(inserted+batch*round, n)
		clock := time.Now()
		adding := enterrors.NewErrorGroupWrapper(logger)
		for from, c := inserted, 0; from < to; from, c = from+batch, c+1 {
			upto := min(from+batch, to)
			adding.Go(func() error {
				vectors, buf, err := train.read(order[from:upto], bufs[c])
				bufs[c] = buf
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				return p.AddBatch(ctx, order[from:upto], vectors)
			})
		}
		if err := adding.Wait(); err != nil {
			shut()
			t.Fatalf("inserts %d to %d: %v", inserted, to, err)
		}
		if !wasBuilt {
			require.NoError(t, p.settleBase(ctx))
		}
		require.NoError(t, p.Flush())
		took := time.Since(clock)
		switch {
		case !wasBuilt && p.g != nil:
			result.BaseSeconds, result.Base = took.Seconds(), to
			t.Logf("the base: %d vectors in %d postings, built in %s", p.g.meta.Live, p.g.meta.Postings,
				took.Round(time.Second))
			lastAt, lastInserted = time.Now(), to
		case wasBuilt:
			insertTime += took
		}
		inserted = to
		if p.g != nil && (time.Since(lastAt) >= stretchEvery || inserted == n) {
			stretch()
		}
	}
	settle := time.Now()
	require.NoError(t, p.Settle(ctx))
	result.SettleSecs = time.Since(settle).Seconds()
	stretch()
	shutAt := time.Now()
	shut()
	result.ShutSeconds = time.Since(shutAt).Seconds()
	result.DirBytesDone, err = nightDirBytes(dir)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	result.Done = true
	writeNightJSON(t, out, result)
	t.Logf("done: %d vectors, %.0f s of inserts after the base, %.1f GB on disk", n, result.Seconds,
		float64(result.DirBytesDone)/1e9)
}

// TestNightHeap opens the index TestNightGrow left, in the cache mode of
// PE_CACHE, over the store as a shard opens it but with no cycle running,
// collects, and writes the profile of the heap in use with nothing of a
// harness loaded. Run it with -test.memprofilerate=1.
func TestNightHeap(t *testing.T) {
	dir, heapOut, out := os.Getenv("PE_DIR"), os.Getenv("PE_HEAP"), os.Getenv("PE_OUT")
	if dir == "" || heapOut == "" || out == "" {
		t.Skip("no PE_DIR, PE_HEAP and PE_OUT given")
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	logger := logrus.New()
	logger.SetLevel(logrus.WarnLevel)
	uc := ent.NewDefaultUserConfig()
	uc.RQ.CacheMode = nightEnv("PE_CACHE", ent.CacheModeRouting)
	begin := time.Now()
	st := openNightStore(t, dir, logger, false)
	p, err := Open(st.config(dir, logger, 0), uc, st.store)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	opened := time.Since(begin)
	defer func() {
		require.NoError(t, p.Shutdown(ctx))
		require.NoError(t, st.store.Shutdown(ctx))
	}()
	runtime.GC()
	runtime.GC()
	var mem runtime.MemStats
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&mem)
	file, err := os.Create(heapOut)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, pprof.Lookup("heap").WriteTo(file, 0))
	require.NoError(t, file.Close())

	p.mu.RLock()
	g := p.g
	deleted := 0
	for _, d := range g.deleted {
		if d {
			deleted++
		}
	}
	info := map[string]any{
		"cacheMode": uc.RQ.CacheMode, "openSeconds": opened.Seconds(),
		"heapInuse": mem.HeapInuse, "heapAlloc": mem.HeapAlloc, "heapSys": mem.HeapSys, "sys": mem.Sys,
		"meta": g.meta, "noCodes": g.noCodes, "liveSlots": len(g.live), "deletedLen": len(g.deleted),
		"deleted": deleted, "builtAtLen": len(g.builtAt), "pendingHeap": g.pendingHeap(),
		"pendingPostings": len(g.pending), "pendingMembers": g.pendingMembers, "pendingBytes": g.pendingBytes,
	}
	p.mu.RUnlock()
	info["livePostings"] = livePostings(g)
	stats, err := g.st.centroids.graph.Stats()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	info["centroidGraph"] = map[string]any{
		"layers": stats.DistributionLayers, "tombstones": stats.NumTombstones, "cacheSize": stats.CacheSize,
		"compressed": stats.Compressed, "type": stats.CompressionType,
	}
	writeNightJSON(t, out, info)
	t.Logf("cache mode %s: opened in %s, heap in use %.1f MB, allocated and in use %.1f MB", uc.RQ.CacheMode,
		opened.Round(time.Second), float64(mem.HeapInuse)/1e6, float64(mem.HeapAlloc)/1e6)
}
